claim: A second Qwen3.5 seed with new fusion weights improved nested grouped validation but degraded on Public.
do_not_repeat: Do not promote another Qwen3.5 seed ensemble while simultaneously changing fusion weights or inference pass count.
reopen_if: A single-factor composition passes component_transfer_gate_v1 and the runtime reserve.

claim: Family-diverse positive BAD training passed locked five-fold validation but did not improve the fixed Public-190 composition.
do_not_repeat: Do not tune thresholds or resubmit the same family-diverse adapter recipe.
reopen_if: A new data topology or new model family identifies a distinct mechanism and passes component_transfer_gate_v1.

claim: Production family priors do not mask the local changes of component 260.
do_not_repeat: Do not attribute the Public tie to downstream exact/name/numeric/shingle overrides.
reopen_if: Hidden per-row predictions become available or the production prior stack changes.

claim: Historical grouped_text_v1 contains exact-text and exact-first-image connected components crossing folds, so local neighbour and residual methods require an exclusion guard.
do_not_repeat: Do not claim absolute family isolation from grouped_text_v1 or evaluate nearest/prototype/residual methods using unsafe connected components as donors or selection rows.
reopen_if: A fully retrained connected-component split is produced for every expensive baseline component.

claim: Cross-fitted soft probabilities harmed the Qwen3.5 specialist, especially the rare flammable category.
do_not_repeat: Do not replace hard labels by the same teacher-derived soft targets or promote the completed full adapter.
reopen_if: A category-aware target construction preserves hard targets for rare positives and is independently justified before outer scoring.

claim: A label-blind regulatory selector identifies the BAD error region, but the frozen linear residual cannot separate corrections from regressions.
do_not_repeat: Do not refit or package the same cue-count Ridge residual and do not attribute its failure to downstream priors.
reopen_if: A genuinely different representation or pairwise hard-negative objective passes the same connected and prior gates.

claim: Consensus and calibrated confidence among the three production scores cannot reliably select errors of 190.
do_not_repeat: Do not restack or vote the same production scores under another generic confidence rule.
reopen_if: A new inference-available causal feature such as counterfactual text sensitivity separates corrections from regressions and passes connected validation.

claim: Counterfactual removal of regulatory and sports spans measures a real text shortcut but does not predict sports-BAD errors reliably.
do_not_repeat: Do not tune the same span-removal signs or thresholds after seeing outer labels.
reopen_if: A new representation learns transferable hard-negative geometry rather than another hand-coded sports rule.

claim: A learned hard-negative diagonal metric produces disagreements but the predeclared top-two-percent total-confidence selector abstains everywhere.
do_not_repeat: Do not weaken the frozen total-confidence threshold and report it as experiment 360.
reopen_if: A separately versioned flammable-only disagreement rule replicates across all three predeclared connected topologies without changing BAD.

claim: The flammable hard-negative disagreement signal is positive on average but not stable enough for acceptance.
do_not_repeat: Do not tune the same first-image threshold post hoc or package experiment 370 as a production candidate.
reopen_if: The same frozen flammable-only mechanism is re-evaluated with the all-image embedding representation used by production experiment 190 and passes the connected replication gate.

claim: Production-parity all-image embeddings preserve a weak positive hard-negative signal, but a single metric remains topology-unstable.
do_not_repeat: Do not tune the disagreement quantile after observing experiment 380 or package the single metric.
reopen_if: A predeclared family-bagged metric stabilizes all three connected replications while retaining production parity.

claim: Unanimous bagging of three metrics trained on 80 percent of each outer donor set does not eliminate topology instability.
do_not_repeat: Do not tune the family fraction, seeds or quantile on the same topology results.
reopen_if: A different validation-safe ensemble uses full 80-percent topology donors rather than subsampling them again.

claim: The Public tie of experiment 280 can be decomposed into opposing category effects; routing adapters by the known category preserves the strong flammable gain without the BAD loss.
do_not_repeat: Do not replace the original BAD adapter or retune category thresholds from the Public result.
reopen_if: The category-routed candidate receives a Public score and row-level effects need further diagnosis.

claim: The gains of category routing 400 concentrate on explicit gas and fuel products, while its main local risk is positive-to-negative regression on singleton ignition and pyrotechnic kits.
do_not_repeat: Do not post-hoc edit or threshold candidate 400 from these 26 labels.
reopen_if: A separately versioned training hypothesis improves the frozen connected and recall gates.

claim: Experiment 250 was not launch-ready as written because its executable still enabled rejected positive-family balancing and targeted the failed 230 parent; the mechanism is carried forward as isolated experiment 410 on the exact 260 recipe.
do_not_repeat: Do not launch the old 250 cycle or combine rejected positive balancing with negative-family diversity.
reopen_if: A strict donor-only hard-mining baseline is trained for a separate validation version.

claim: Replacing repeated flammable negatives by 1600 distinct text families makes the routed Qwen3.5 specialist too conservative and materially reduces rare-class recall.
do_not_repeat: Do not add more flammable-negative diversity or negative pressure to the experiment-260 adapter and do not package the completed full adapter.
reopen_if: A separately frozen recall-oriented continuation changes the training direction and passes the two-fold reject screen before a full cycle.

claim: A short low-learning-rate balanced flammable continuation of adapter 260 further increases false negatives instead of restoring rare-class recall.
do_not_repeat: Do not continue the same experiment-260 adapter with another balanced positive replay, repeat the seed, train the remaining folds, or package the continued adapter.
reopen_if: A genuinely different representation or objective targets flammable evidence without fine-tuning the already saturated adapter and is frozen before validation.

claim: Exact one-pass interpolation between the original 190 and flammable-specialized 260 LoRA deltas has a consistent alpha-0.50 optimum and improves recall, but its small gain is not stable enough for production acceptance.
do_not_repeat: Do not relax the frozen 4-of-5, correction-ratio, or connected-bootstrap gates after seeing the result; do not build a full adapter or submission from experiment 430.
reopen_if: Alpha 0.50 is carried unchanged into a separately versioned independent confirmation or combined with a genuinely independent representation that passes its own frozen validation.

claim: Experiment 400 residual flammable errors are transaction-scope errors rather than duplicate leakage, while a substantial part of BAD residual error lies in mixed-label connected components.
do_not_repeat: Do not convert post-hoc cohort expressions into rules or thresholds on the same labels, and do not attribute the residual flammable errors to exact-family leakage.
reopen_if: A label-blind transaction-scope representation is frozen before predictions and passes an independent two-fold reject screen.

claim: Adding alpha-1 symmetric binary R-Drop KL to the unchanged Qwen3-VL adapter training objective materially hurts the routed flammable classifier on two preselected folds.
do_not_repeat: Do not train the remaining folds, repeat the seed, tune R-Drop alpha on these results, or package this component.
reopen_if: A separately frozen objective uses a different mechanism and demonstrates positive results on both reject-only folds.

claim: A cross-fitted linear classifier over title and label-blind transaction-scope sentences does not add transferable signal to the flammable route of experiment 400.
do_not_repeat: Do not tune the scope vocabulary or weights after observing these folds and do not turn the seven changed examples into rules.
reopen_if: A separately frozen model represents relations between product, included contents and compatibility rather than filtering sentences with keywords.

claim: A frozen cross-fitted linear head over Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B multimodal vectors is substantially weaker than the experiment-400 flammable route and adds harmful ensemble pressure on every fold.
do_not_repeat: Do not tune the embedding weight grid or classifier after these results and do not add this component to the submission runtime.
reopen_if: A genuinely different frozen use of the embeddings is justified independently of these labels, such as retrieval diagnostics rather than direct classification.

claim: The fixed alpha-0.50 Qwen3.5 adapter soup has a small positive mean under an independent seed but is not stable across the two preselected folds.
do_not_repeat: Do not train the remaining folds, package a full alpha-0.50 soup, or tune alpha on the observed seed-repeat folds.
reopen_if: A separately frozen merge uses train-only block importance rather than another global alpha and passes both reject-only folds.

claim: The current champion and category-routed candidate use only four generic explanations and do not meet the organizer's newly clarified concrete-evidence expectation for final manual review.
do_not_repeat: Do not treat format-valid generic templates or unconstrained free-form chain-of-thought as sufficient explanations.
reopen_if: A verdict-locked evidence-first layer reaches at least 90 percent relevance on the frozen 200-row manual audit with under 1 percent unsupported claims and passes runtime.

claim: A verdict-locked post-hoc comment layer can provide evidence-grounded justification but must not be described as a causally faithful explanation of the classifier.
do_not_repeat: Do not generate free chain-of-thought or claim that an exact substring alone proves relevance, scope, or causal faithfulness.
reopen_if: Text-only coverage is insufficient on the frozen audit and a separately verified visual-evidence path is required.

claim: Post-470 validation is reproducible but not strict end-to-end nested CV; small positive post-selection deltas can be optimistic.
do_not_repeat: Do not promote a candidate from candidate-specific nested thresholds or global-OOF hard mining without production replay and strict outer-nested selection.
reopen_if: A sealed semantic/perceptual family holdout and strictly outer-nested selector audit confirm the candidate.

claim: Category routing in experiment 400 transferred positively to Public, but by much less than either the original locked validation or the exact production replay predicted.
do_not_repeat: Do not tune thresholds, routing or related hypotheses against this Public observation and do not assume the fourth-decimal gain will persist on Private.
reopen_if: A newly frozen semantic-family protocol independently confirms a challenger or Private confirms the direction.

claim: Increasing the single first-image resolution from 448 to 672 changes predictions but consistently hurts the locked category-routed solution.
do_not_repeat: Do not train folds 1 2 4, tune the resolution after these results, or assume more visual tokens improve small-text recognition.
reopen_if: A separately frozen crop or OCR mechanism changes the evidence source rather than only increasing global resolution.

claim: Training the flammable Qwen3.5 component to emit a long verdict-plus-evidence suffix sharply degrades the frozen route-400 classification boundary despite exact first-token and data contracts.
do_not_repeat: Do not reuse the six-line suffix at unit loss weight or scale it to five folds; explanation learning must be decoupled or much more carefully weighted and independently audited.
reopen_if: A new experiment freezes the verdict head and adds a separately weighted evidence objective without changing first-token calibration.

claim: A donor-only batch-local pairwise margin inside mixed BAD families does not improve the exact route-400 parent even when the pointwise multiset and flammable route are unchanged.
do_not_repeat: Do not retune the same margin or pair weight on these folds; any future BAD contrastive branch needs a different representation or sealed-family evidence.

claim: Preserving exact-evidence sentences inside the same 1800-character budget has a large but fold-unstable effect and is unsafe as a direct replacement for the route-400 flammable component.
do_not_repeat: Do not train the remaining historical folds or tune the sentence packer against this sign change.
reopen_if: The unchanged mechanism is evaluated once on the newly sealed semantic-family protocol without any parameter selection.

claim: Replacing the frozen Qwen3-VL rank by a pairwise-trained InternVL rank on the hard flammable selector sharply reduces recall on both screen folds.
do_not_repeat: Do not tune the same replacement weight, extend to five folds or repeat the seed; the learned pairwise boundary is too conservative.
reopen_if: A future relative objective is calibrated jointly with pointwise recall on the new sealed protocol rather than replacing ranks post hoc.

claim: Adding a batch-local flammable pairwise margin to the exact pointwise Qwen3.5 parent makes the target boundary substantially more conservative on both screen folds.
do_not_repeat: Do not tune the hinge weight or margin, extend to the remaining historical folds, or repeat the seed after observing this screen.
reopen_if: A future pointwise objective changes the data support under the sealed semantic-family protocol rather than adding another relative loss.

claim: Reducing grounded-evidence token weight to 0.05 removes the large average collapse of experiment 520 but leaves a strong fold-sign reversal.
do_not_repeat: Do not tune evidence-token weight on folds 0 and 3, extend this recipe to remaining historical folds, or repeat its seed.
reopen_if: A separately frozen multi-task design decouples explanation learning from the calibrated verdict head and is evaluated under semantic-v3.

claim: Cycling through real gallery views during Qwen3-VL training while keeping first-image inference consistently harms the route-400 boundary.
do_not_repeat: Do not train remaining historical folds or tune the gallery cycle after observing this result.
reopen_if: A label-blind product-identity audit proves a donor view preserves the same sold object and label-relevant visual evidence, as in the separately versioned cross-listing experiment.

claim: Even exact-text or exact-image listing edges with corroboration do not reach the predeclared 98 percent precision required for cross-listing visual recombination.
do_not_repeat: Do not relax the 98 percent gate or launch the prepared GPU screen after seeing the eight contradictions.
reopen_if: A new identity rule explicitly proves quantity bundle and sold-object equivalence on a fresh blind sample under a new experiment ID.

claim: A strict label-blind position-only parser can block all 11 known semantic failures of experiment 500, but its independent in-distribution support is too small for the frozen audit gate.
do_not_repeat: Do not lower the 100-pair minimum, reuse the 73 development IDs, audit screen folds 0/3, or launch training from the unreviewed 91-pair pool.
reopen_if: A separately versioned parser or additional in-distribution development data provides at least 100 new eligible IDs while retaining the 98 percent semantic and kappa 0.80 gates.

claim: A semantic-v3 disagreement head must not use historical 190/260/400 OOF component scores as fit features because a donor-row score can have been produced by a model trained on the current outer holdout.
do_not_repeat: Do not train a router head on old component OOF scores or treat absence of a direct span as flip evidence.
reopen_if: Complete semantic-v3 experiment-600 and 601 OOF bundles are aligned and a separate label-free backbone compatibility decision is accepted.

claim: The historical category-routed specialist direction does not transfer to semantic-v3, while the fixed four-seed probability mean improves the full locked route but remains fold-unstable.
do_not_repeat: Do not promote the semantic-v3 specialist route or tune seed subsets weights or thresholds on these OOF results.
reopen_if: The unchanged four-seed mean is used as one frozen component inside a separately predeclared mechanism and passes its own outer-nested and sealed gates.

claim: Successful computation is not sufficient artifact acceptance: object-dtype string arrays violate pickle-free loading even when numeric score tensors are valid.

scope.confirmed_cause: pandas string Series serialized as NumPy object arrays

do_not_repeat: Test every serialized array dtype with allow_pickle=false before launching a quality grid.

claim: High binary-normalized support from a generic open model is not a safe verdict router even when an exact compatible span and an independent component vote are required.
do_not_repeat: Do not interpret a two-logit support ratio as calibrated policy confidence or let it independently change a verdict.

claim: A per-block Fisher mixture of two rank-16 LoRA updates is not reliably compressible back to the frozen rank before validation: the same layer-11 k_proj violates the predeclared reconstruction gate on independent folds.
do_not_repeat: Do not relax the reconstruction limit, raise the rank, or change the compression policy under experiment 621 after observing the failures.
reopen_if: A separately versioned one-pass architecture preserves both updates without post-hoc rank compression and is frozen before validation.

claim: Exact-span multitask supervision strongly improves aggregate Qwen3.5 component quality and safety but remains unstable across semantic families.
do_not_repeat: Do not promote 623, tune its loss weights or thresholds, or select folds after observing the 3/5 result.
reopen_if: A separately versioned mechanism explains and fixes the fold-2/fold-4 flammable regressions on new evidence without tuning on these fold outcomes.

claim: An unstable default argsort can choose different members of an exactly tied hard-example boundary across CPU architectures even with identical inputs and seed.
do_not_repeat: Do not use unstable argsort at a selection boundary in new training code; add a stable secondary key before launching.

claim: A frozen compact multilingual embedding with a linear classifier is substantially weaker than strict word-and-character TF-IDF on both semantic-family screen folds.
do_not_repeat: Do not replace the TF-IDF head with the same frozen representation or spend GPU on its finetuning without a new mechanism that first passes an independent representation-level screen.

claim: Exact-span validity is not a semantic safety gate: two independent seeds improve BAD but move the fold-4 flammable boundary toward false positives, and stable-rank fusion amplifies small promotions near the rare-class threshold.
do_not_repeat: Do not treat an exact substring or OCR box as sufficient evidence that the phrase describes the sold object or supports the verdict; report object scope, negation, gallery position and semantic-family support separately.

claim: Increasing prompting scale from a 27B dense Qwen to Qwen3.5-122B-A10B does not improve the frozen product-policy boundary and sharply harms the rare flammable category.
do_not_repeat: Do not distill the same fixed-prompt 122B outputs or tune its prompt and threshold on the released outer folds.
reopen_if: A separately trained large-model LoRA passes the frozen class and evidence gates on new predictions.

claim: Supervised class-only adaptation is the dominant difference between the 4B prompting cell and the trained 4B cell on the frozen two-fold screen.
do_not_repeat: Do not compare this component score directly with the full ensemble 140 or infer submission quality from a two-fold component screen.

claim: A mature four-GPU model-parallel runtime can train and reload a Qwen3.6-27B LoRA without CPU or disk offload.
do_not_repeat: Do not treat technical viability as evidence that 27B improves quality; compare it against 641 under the frozen scientific contract.

claim: A source-level OCR parseability counter is insufficient for immutable evidence data because outputs with complete early regions can still be truncated inside a later coordinate block.
do_not_repeat: Do not publish OCR weak labels from region-count checks alone; require EOS, complete coordinate blocks, identity preservation and a second immutable bundle verification.

claim: OCR repair sharding must be sized from the strict candidate count and measured row throughput, and simply increasing generation length does not repair malformed dense-image spotting output.
do_not_repeat: Do not launch a full repair fleet before a bounded end-to-end smoke passes; do not assume EOS or a larger token budget guarantees a valid multiple-of-eight coordinate structure.

claim: A larger supervised Qwen3.6-27B class-only adapter can strongly improve the rare flammable category while still failing as a global replacement because it trades away BAD precision and creates more total regressions than corrections.
do_not_repeat: Do not weaken the global gate after seeing the rare-category gain; any flammable-only route must be a new pre-registered experiment and full-system comparison.

claim: One deterministic tiling level repairs most dense OCR rows but does not bound output length when text density is concentrated inside one tile.
do_not_repeat: Do not launch the full repair grid from aggregate 6/8 success or increase generation length again; recursively split only a failed tile under the same strict leaf gate.

claim: Gemma 4 E4B transfers a strong flammable ranking signal on both frozen screen folds but does not pass the deployment decision gate at the fixed zero threshold.
do_not_repeat: Do not tune a threshold weight or calibration on folds 0 and 3 and do not open folds 1 2 4 refit packaging or Public.
reopen_if: A separately preregistered ranking or calibration mechanism selects all parameters strictly inside donor folds and passes a new frozen deployment gate.

claim: Adding a fixed rank loss on top of the full hard-BCE objective preserves a positive mean ranking signal but still shifts the rare-class decision boundary inconsistently across blind confirmation folds.
do_not_repeat: Do not sweep lambda or threshold on observed folds and do not open fold0 full replay refit packaging or Public for experiment 686.
reopen_if: A separately preregistered gradient-control mechanism preserves the hard-label boundary and passes a new blind frozen gate.
